    export type ActivityChange = {
        changeId: number;

        seq: number;
        kind: "span";

    } | {

  ActivityStore (packages/ui-server/src/activity/store.ts)
    export interface ActivityStore {
        readonly writer: string;
        startSpan(input: StartSpanInput): SpanRow;
        endSpan(spanId: string, input: EndSpanInput): boolean;
        patchSpan(spanId: string, patch: {
            principalId?: string;
            attrs?: Record<string, unknown>;
            usage?: SpanUsage;
            waitUntil?: number;
        }): boolean;
        appendEvent(spanId: string, eventType: string, payload: unknown, ts?: number, cap?: number): SpanEventRow | null;
        heartbeat(spanId: string, at?: number): void;
        cascadeClose(runId: string, outcome: SpanOutcome, reason: string): number;
        sweepOwnOrphans(): number;
        sweepStale(staleAfterMs: number, now?: number): number;
        findStuck(thresholdMs: number, now?: number): SpanRow[];
        changesSince(changeCursor: number, limit?: number): ActivityChange[];
        terminalRootChangesSince(changeCursor: number, limit?: number): Array<{
            changeId: number;
            span: SpanRow;
        }>;
        latestChangeCursor(): number;
        snapshotRun(runId: string): RunSnapshot | null;
        runHighWaterSeq(runId: string): number;
        getSpan(spanId: string): SpanRow | null;
        openRootSpans(): SpanRow[];
        runRollup?(runId: string): RunRollupRow | null;
        rollupRun(runId: string): void;
        prune(options: PruneOptions): {
            runsPruned: number;
            spansDeleted: number;
        };
    }

  createInboxResolver (packages/ui-server/src/inbox/resolve.ts)
    export function createInboxResolver(db: Database, deps: {
        allowedOperations: (principalId: string, thread: InboxThread) => readonly InboxOperation[];
        now?: () => number;
        timeZone?: string;
        applyHygiene?: (principalId: string, request: ClientInboxResolve) => Promise<{
            replay: boolean;
            followUpId: string | undefined;
        }>;
    }): {
        inspect: (principalId: string, msg: ClientInboxResolve) => {
            action: InboxActionItem;
            context: null | {
                options_json: string;
                source_item_id: null | string;
            };
            effect: import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").V1ResolutionEffect;
            option: {
                effect: {
                    findingId: string;
                    fingerprint: string;
                    handler?: string | undefined;
                    input?: null | string | string[] | undefined;
                    kind: "hygiene";
                    operation: "check" | "dismiss" | "resolve" | "snooze" | "undo";
                    previewToken?: string | undefined;
                    undoToken?: string | undefined;
                } | {
                    kind: "cancel_blocked";
                } | {
                    kind: "dismiss";
                    reason?: "dont_ask_again" | "need_more_info" | "no_longer_relevant" | "wrong_call" | undefined;
                } | {
                    kind: "enqueue";
                    payload: {
                        instruction: string;
                        operation?: undefined | {
                            input: Record<string, unknown>;
                            targetPath: string;
                            toolName: string;
                        };
                    };
                } | {
                    kind: "open_session";
                    seed: {
                        prompt: string;
                    };
                } | {
                    kind: "snooze";
                } | {
                    kind: "write_policy";
                    policy: {
                        content: string;
                        slug: string;
                    };
                };
                id: string;
                input?: undefined | {
                    example?: string | undefined;
                    type: "date" | "enum" | "none" | "path" | "string" | "strings";
                    values?: string[] | undefined;
                };
                label: string;
                preview?: undefined | {
                    after: string;
                    before: string;
                    changes: {
                        after: string;
                        before: string;
                        line: number;
                    }[];
                    path: string;
                };
            };
            thread: InboxThread;
        };
        resolve(principalId: string, request: ClientInboxResolve, expectedVersion?: number): {
            followUpId: string | undefined;
            replay: boolean;
        };
        resolveAsync(principalId: string, request: ClientInboxResolve, expectedVersion?: number): Promise<{
            followUpId: string | undefined;
            replay: boolean;
        }>;
        snooze(principalId: string, itemId: string, expectedVersion?: number): {
            followUpId: undefined;
            replay: boolean;
        };
    };

            };
            label: string;
            preview?: undefined | {
                after: string;
                before: string;
                changes: {
                    after: string;
                    before: string;
                    line: number;
                }[];
                path: string;
            };
        };
        thread: InboxThread;
    };

  resolveGovernancePolicy (packages/common/src/governance-policy.ts)
    export function resolveGovernancePolicy(policy: GovernancePolicyInput): {
        budgets: {
            day: {
                block_tokens: number;
                block_usd: number;
                warn_tokens?: number | undefined;
                warn_usd: number;
            };
            session: {
                block_tokens: number;
                block_usd: number;
                warn_tokens?: number | undefined;
                warn_usd: number;
            };
            turn: {
                block_tokens: number;
                block_usd: number;
                warn_tokens?: number | undefined;
                warn_usd: number;
            };
        };
        commands: {
            confirm: Array<{
                pattern: string;
                reason?: string;
            }>;
            deny: Array<{
                pattern: string;
                reason?: string;
            }>;
        };
        egress: {
            allow: string[];
            deny: string[];
            max_bytes_per_turn?: number | undefined;
            mode: "allowlist" | "record";
        };
        outward: {
            allow: Array<{
                command: string;
                remotes: string[];
            }>;
            hosts: string[];
        };
        profiles: {
            interactive: "governed" | "strict";
            voice: "governed" | "strict";
        };
        protect: string[];
        providers: Array<{
            allow: string[];
            paths: string[];
        }>;
        release: string[];
        schema_version: 1;
        scope: {
            max_bytes_written: number;
            max_files_changed: number;
            max_minutes: number;
            max_tool_calls: number;
        };
        taint: {
            egress: {
                allow: string[];
            };
        };
    };
